LanguageData.HP_Setup: Choose how to initialize this world's free cities. Keeping the existing world changes no ownership. Configuring initial cities moves the reviewed NPC settlements into one REAL Free City Union faction with shared diplomacy, standard union trade/defenders and ideology. Player faction, visited towns, loaded maps, charter records and each source faction's last base are excluded. Player membership, council votes, automatic wars and conquest are not connected yet. This is world setup, not negotiated NPC independence. Gameplay validation is deferred. Closing this window defers the choice.

LanguageData.PA_Warning: DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW — Confirming membership changes REAL external goodwill and war/peace relations for ALL player settlements to match the selected authority, including future changes. Relations with the authority start at +100 (ally). Your colony and pawns remain player-controlled. Review the relations below before confirming. Union exit requires 3 days' notice, resolved physical transfers and a signed new liege contract; there is no unilateral exit button yet. Union levies, council votes and automatic protection are not implemented. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.PA_Notice: Give 3 days' notice of union departure

LanguageData.PA_ApplyLiege: Confirm signed liege allegiance and apply shared diplomacy
LanguageData.PA_RelationsChanged: Shared diplomacy changed the relationship with: {0}. The game has been paused for review.

LanguageData.CT_Warning: DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW — Confirming changes this NPC town's REAL faction, shared diplomacy, future inhabitants, trade and faction ideology/technology. Player bases and pawns remain under player control. Visited towns can move only while unloaded, with supported saved residents and verifiably unchanged trade goods. People, corpses, nested stock and unsupported animals are excluded. Supported living world-pawn trade animals retain their identity, faction and observed health/gear/status without refactioning. Existing goods are neither regenerated nor confiscated; future trade and restocking follow the destination faction. Hostility and pending delivery block movement. Real source factions keep another base; only your verified administration may become empty. Released towns need an existing union and no newer active contract. Signing/releasing remains separate from movement. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.CT_Active: Apply the mutually signed charter: the NPC town joins the player's current shared political authority while remaining an NPC town.
LanguageData.CT_Released: Apply the mutually released charter: the NPC town joins the existing Free City Union. Old contracts and execution history are preserved. This is not a unilateral independence ruling.
LanguageData.CT_Recover: Check interrupted change: confirm destination or cancel if unmoved
LanguageData.CT_Unavailable: Territory change unavailable. Check signed/released status, unresolved proposals, player shared authority or existing union, current ownership, source's remaining bases, unloaded map, saved inhabitants, ordinary stock and pending deliveries. Changed stock requires a fresh review; changed stock during a pending move blocks recovery. A town already at the destination needs no move. Resolve interrupted moves first.
LanguageData.CT_Applied: Faction change applied; actual ownership verified
LanguageData.AD_Warning: Optional NPC administration for your vassal towns. Establishing it adds a REAL faction with an internal +100 alliance; external diplomacy follows the player, and external goodwill events involving its towns affect player diplomacy. Your own bases and pawns remain player-controlled. This preview uses industrial outlander troops, trade and ideology, rather than preserving player/local culture. Quest or permanent relation conflicts suspend mirroring. Random raids, military aid and quest sites are disabled; compatibility with every other quest/mod is untested.
LanguageData.AD_Suspended: Administration diplomacy suspended. Resolve internal hostility, player allegiance suspension or quest/permanent relation conflicts, then resume. Existing towns and ownership records are preserved.
LanguageData.AD_Unavailable: Administration unavailable. A live player colony and valid unique administration are required. Establish it while unaffiliated. A defeated/duplicate faction cannot be replaced; goodwill caps, locked relations or suspended player allegiance may block sharing.
LanguageData.FB_Open: Align vassal towns with current polity
LanguageData.FB_Warning: Review ALL active NPC city vassals against your current administration/union/liege. New allegiance changes include this follower review. All moves are checked first, including cumulative source losses and existing ordinary stock. Real sources retain another base; only your administration may become empty. Visited towns may move with preserved ordinary goods, but loaded maps, unsupported residents, people/unsupported animals or nested stock block movement. A town already at the destination needs no move. Transfers execute one at a time. If interrupted, completed moves remain; recover the pending city against its saved stock evidence, then review the remaining group. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.FB_Complete: Vassal alignment completed: {0} faction changes verified.
LanguageData.FB_Incomplete: Vassal alignment is incomplete or the reviewed state changed. Completed changes are retained. Resolve pending ownership, recheck player allegiance/diplomacy and review the whole group again.
LanguageData.PS_Warning: Membership and ALL active NPC city vassals are now reviewed together. Confirmation applies real player diplomacy, then moves the reviewed cities with per-city ownership proof. A staged intent is saved; partial progress is retained rather than rolled back or called complete. Nothing resumes automatically after loading. If interrupted, check any pending city, review the remaining diplomacy/towns, then resume. Only preparation with unchanged player allegiance and city journal can be cancelled. Other contract changes and new physical deliveries wait until resolution. Existing unpaid debts remain owed.

LanguageData.PS_Incomplete: Political transition is incomplete or the review changed. Verified stages and cities are retained. Check pending ownership, then review/resume here. If allegiance never changed and the city journal is unchanged, cancel preparation instead. No automatic rollback or restart was performed.

LanguageData.CA_Note: READ-ONLY INSPECTION. No ownership, pawn status, inventory, contract or execution journal is changed. Optional baseline buttons store or discard a separate diagnostic record. This report does not approve a move or recover an interrupted one. Saved residents remain unsupported: the native pawn faction API also resets guest status, surgery bills, medical settings and mental/job state. Stock is read without generating or restocking it. Counts refer to saved references or stock entries, not stack units. Flags may overlap. Inspect again after changes; actual transfer review still applies all contract, destination, diplomacy and resource checks. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.RB_Note: Save one optional baseline of the town's referenced residents, factions, health, direct gear and selected status. Saving replaces the previous baseline, even for another town. It is retained in your game save; discarding clears only this record. Comparison does not move residents or repair losses. It covers only the listed observations, not every medical setting, memory or mod state. Normal time progression can cause differences. A missing reference does not prove death, and matching observations do not authorize migration. Counts can overlap. No automatic recovery or dishonor is applied.

LanguageData.NS_Warning: Change the immediate liege of an existing NPC vassal within your current realm, or return it to direct player allegiance. All affected towns must already share your actual realm. The realm's living NPC representative must agree under the current policy (player goodwill at least 50). Review first, then confirm. This changes REAL saved contracts, not pawn or settlement factions. The old contract is mutually released and replaced atomically, keeping its history and the exact contracts of all descendants. Fixed tribute terms remain the same with the new direct counterpart. Four levels including the top lord are enforced across the whole tree. NPC payments are not generated. Ordinary single-town release cannot detach a lord with active descendants; reassign those children first. Whole-subtree union release is still pending. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.NS_Rejected: Hierarchy review unavailable. Choose distinct current vassals in the same aligned realm, a willing living representative and a hierarchy within four levels. Resolve pending political/physical transfers first. Self-contracts, cycles and unchanged immediate lieges are excluded.

LanguageData.NW_Warning: OPTIONAL WORLD SETUP, once per save. Create internal NPC vassal contracts among a reviewed share of existing towns in each eligible native faction, without changing their faction, residents or stock. The living faction leader represents both sides as an initial internal land arrangement, not a player-negotiated NPC independence agreement. Factions already registered in the contract book, the union, player administration, hostile/hidden/temporary/defeated/permanent-enemy and royal-title factions are excluded. Existing politics and player contracts are never rewritten. The native faction is the root, with branches no deeper than four levels; at most 30 towns are configured. Terms are fixed tribute value 100 every 5 days with a 1-day grace period and 10% subject-delivery transport share. No NPC goods/payments or military events are generated. Review the towns and representatives before confirming. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.WM_Warning: If the new realm is hostile to the former sovereign, the former sovereign's ACTUAL recorded mutual release can cover its own player-vassal towns during this reviewed transition. It never covers unrelated source factions or voids new-realm admission, quest locks, goodwill caps, ownership, stock, map/resident or remaining-base checks. The exception ends when the transition completes; it does not create a war or a breach claim.

Internal contracts, terms and old debts remain. Confirmed release cannot be undone here. Pending exits block other political edits; recover any interrupted city first, then review and resume. Unapplied, wholly unchanged preparation alone may be cancelled. No automatic load recovery. Unsupported residents, loaded maps and unsupported stock remain blocked for physical moves. Wartime admission without verified acceptance is unavailable.

LanguageData.RE_Limits: Resident migration is limited to 1–128 eligible ordinary humanlike world pawns in an unloaded town. Started/resource-bound/custom surgery, prisoners/slaves/guests, leaders/titles, ideology, genes/special states, active jobs, mental states and persistent area/master restrictions are deferred. Identity, observed health/gear/social/need data and medical settings must match. Original unstarted standard medical orders are held through native clearing and restored without new IDs. Only recorded medical care and proven missing load links are repairable; health/gear/social state is not rewritten. Pending references are protected from world-pawn GC only until resolution. Recovery is explicit and strict: natural state changes can also block it, without implying blame.

LanguageData.RE_Unsupported: {0}: saved residents do not meet the supported preservation conditions. Started/resource-bound/custom surgery, custody/leadership, ideology/special state, jobs or settings may require later support. Town migration is deferred.
